About

Hi there! I'm Hemanth Narayanaswamy.

I'm a DevOps and Platform Developer based in Canada, with about 5+ years of experience turning manual processes into reliable infrastructure. I help teams ship confidently, scale smoothly, and recover quickly.

My Story

My work connects platform engineering, site reliability, and automation across Linux-based cloud and on-premises systems. I build on AWS and Google Cloud with Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD. Python is at the core of my automation toolkit, alongside SQL and experience building production ML training pipelines.

I enjoy following logs, connecting metrics, and digging into system behavior until I understand what's going wrong. Then I look for ways to automate the fix, reduce downtime, and make the next incident easier to diagnose.

Beyond the terminal

Anime enthusiast. Always up for a new cloud or tooling certification challenge.
